query.name: com.psugasia.ptc5.signups.section
query.sql:
select nvl(ssp.room,e.room) as room, ssp.onlineurl
from sections e inner join teachers t on e.teacher = t.id left outer join u_ptc5_cc pd on d.id = pd.ccid and pd.u_ptc5_sessionsid = :sessionid left outer join teachers t2 on pd.schoolstaffdcid = t2.dcid left outer join u_schoolstaff_ptc5 ssp on nvl(t2.dcid,t.dcid) = ssp.schoolstaffdcid
where e.dcid = :sectiondcid

query.name: com.psugasia.ptc5.signups.section.timeslots
query.sql:
with sectionptcteacheroverride as ( select distinct e.dcid, pc.schoolstaffdcid
from u_ptc5_cc pc inner join cc d on pc.ccid = d.id inner join sections e on d.sectionid = e.id inner join students s on d.studentid = s.id
where pc.u_ptc5_sessionsid = :sessionid and s.dcid = :studentdcid and e.dcid = :sectiondcid ), sectionptcteacher as ( select e.dcid as sectiondcid, t.dcid as schoolstaffdcid
from sections e inner join teachers t on e.teacher = t.id
where e.dcid = :sectiondcid and e.dcid not in (select distinct dcid from (select * from sectionptcteacheroverride) where dcid is not null) )
select pt.id, pt.startdt, pt.enddt, pt.capacity
from u_ptc5_timeslots pt left outer join u_ptc5_timeslots_courses ptc on pt.id = ptc.u_ptc5_timeslotsid left outer join u_ptc5_timeslots_sections pte on pt.id = pte.u_ptc5_timeslotsid left outer join u_ptc5_timeslots_schoolstaff ptss on pt.id = ptss.u_ptc5_timeslotsid
where pt.u_ptc5_sessionsid = :sessionid and (ptc.coursedcid is null or ptc.coursedcid = (select c2.dcid from sections e2 inner join courses c2 on e2.course_number = c2.course_number where e2.dcid = :sectiondcid)) and (pte.sectiondcid is null or pte.sectiondcid = (select e2.dcid from sections e2 where e2.dcid = :sectiondcid)) and (ptss.schoolstaffdcid is null or ptss.schoolstaffdcid = (select schoolstaffdcid from (select * from sectionptcteacher))) and nvl(pt.admin,0) = 0 and nvl(pt.status,0) = 1 and pt.grade_levels like '%,'||(select grade_level from students where dcid = :studentdcid)||',%' and (:ismustmeet = '1' or (:ismustmeet = '0' and nvl(pt.mustmeet,0) = 0)) and pt.id not in ( select u_ptc5_timeslotsid from u_ptc5_timeslots_blocked where schoolstaffdcid = :schoolstaffdcid and status = 1 )
order by pt.startdt, pt.enddt
